description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Fiora''' empowers her next two [[basic attack]]s [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] within 4 seconds to gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 25 '''bonus''' range and [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed.
description.text: Active: Fiora empowers her next two basic attacks on-attack within 4 seconds to gain  25 bonus range and  bonus attack speed.

description2.raw: The first attack [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] the target by 30% for 1 second but cannot [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]]. The second attack will [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] for [[File:Critical strike damage icon.png|15px|link=Critical strike]] '''modified''' critical damage, including to [[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|structures]].
description2.text: The first attack slows the target by 30% for 1 second but cannot critically strike. The second attack will critically strike for  modified critical damage, including to structures.

description3.raw: ''Bladework [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Fiora's''' basic attack timer.''
description3.text: Bladework resets Fiora's basic attack timer.

notes.raw: * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will only block the slow from the first hit. * [[File:Sundered Sky item.png|20xpx|border|link=Sundered Sky|An icon for the item Sundered Sky]] [[Sundered Sky|Sundered Sky's]] Lightshield Strike's critical damage will override ''Bladework's'' if the resulting damage would be higher. ** This does not account for any critical damage bonuses that may affect Lightshield Strike. * ''Bladework's'' first basic attack will slow even if it is [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]], [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] or [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|missed]]. * Neither ''Bladework'' attack will deal damage if it is [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]], [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] or [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|missed]].
notes.text:
Spell shield will only block the slow from the first hit.
Sundered Sky's Lightshield Strike's critical damage will override Bladework's if the resulting damage would be higher.
* This does not account for any critical damage bonuses that may affect Lightshield Strike.
Bladework's first basic attack will slow even if it is dodged, blocked or missed.
Neither Bladework attack will deal damage if it is dodged, blocked or missed.
